correctness.rationale: For n>=3, rung edges are precisely edges contained in no triangles, forcing Aut(K_n square K_2)=S_n x C2. A matching is uniquely (R,A,B) with n-|R|=2h. The stabilizer of A classifies B by alternating-cycle partition lambda; cycle factors 2^(t-1)(t-1)! yield the orbit weight. A four-cycle is either within one clique or a 2-rung rectangle: direct count is 2h(h-1)+C(k,2)+m1(lambda). Counting rung-changing flips at the higher-rung endpoint gives the undirected edge census, not double-counting. The separate constructive switching argument connects all states, including odd n. Independent new direct graph generation for n=3,4,5,6 obtained (vertices,edges) (4,3),(16,30),(56,130),(376,1860) with exact local degree checks; finite tests only corroborate the general proof.
